profile: Actual BTCUSDC aggregate executed quantities in fixed 50-USDC price bins; top five separated smoothed peaks, each zone peak +/- one bin. Full 15m buckets with one-minute delay; current UTC session, rolling 1/7/60 days, latest confirmed 4h swing anchor. Two following 4h bars must finish before recognizing swing; anchor starts at original swing bar open, known only after confirmation. Overlapping periods are not independent evidence.
direction: Daily and 4h close relative to EMA20 establish direction; opposing votes abstain. 1h and 15m close relative to EMA20 must agree for new risk. Completed 3m zone reclaim/rejection and completed 1m candle confirmation govern orders.
controller: Campaign initial account cash/10 per addition, quantity rounded down. Five allocated units enter defensive mode; opposing zone reaction reduces to three even at a loss; tactical zone two-close failure cuts to two. Fixed deeper week/60d thesis zone failure exits all. Additional entries require a distinct more favorable zone and better execution reference than last add, not an ATR distance. Remaining five units reserved in this initial version.
comparison: 18 predeclared one-month accounts: three policies x three research leverage assumptions x two cost cases. day_only uses same multi-timeframe direction with rolling one-day volume profile only, isolating profile horizons imperfectly through changed exposures. no_add uses multiscale profiles but never increases initial tenth. E054 numbers are historical context, not a controlled ablation.
limitations: Reused historical August 2026, no fresh holdout
50-USDC bins and reaction rules are fixed researcher assumptions, not inferred user discretion
Trade volume is not outstanding orderbook liquidity or known holder cost basis
Average-cost PnL; newest allocation tracking inherits E054 pooled remnants
No validated exchange margin/liquidation or live fills
User leverage unspecified; 4% drawdown halt remains a provisional research guard
